The delivered theorems establish sharp simultaneous common-CDF, pointwise CCP, state-effect, and prefix-conditioned bounds at a fixed feasible structural index, but the contribution remains restricted to fixed T, a binary AR(1) index, and objectives factoring through periodwise latent-bin marginals.

proof_attempt_summary: The run derived and fully discharged the fixed-index sharp common-response-CDF band, constructive endpoint laws, state-effect interval, prefix-conditioned three-slope projection, measurable extension, and locally robust T=3 strictness witness. Repeated source and scaffold audits repaired prior-art attribution, projection scope, feasibility quantifiers, and statement drift; the final mathematics passed, but the durable fixed-T binary/fixed-index scope remained subfield rather than field. A future upgrade must add a genuinely broader result rather than rerun the same angle.
tldr: At a fixed feasible index in a short dynamic binary panel, partial stationarity identifies the entire common counterfactual response CDF sharply: the simultaneous set is \(\{F:L_z\le F\le U_z\}\), and every pointwise policy CCP fills \([L_z(c),U_z(c)]\). Liu's published dynamic lower formula equals \(L_z\), and its upper formula equals \(U_z\) away from factual-index ties; at ties the exact weak-success boundary is generally tighter. The missing converse, simultaneous compatibility, constructive attainment, sharp state-effect contrasts, the secondary prefix-history three-slope refinement, and Borel endpoint laws for continuous exogenous support are all established without serial independence or parametric errors. In the explicit positive \(T=3\) witness, the strict prefix-CCP and state-effect improvements persist on a relative open neighborhood of feasible positive observed laws within the fixed threshold-order cell.
gap: Khan--Ponomareva--Tamer and the KPT follow-up by Mbakop sharply characterize structural parameters, not fixed-index counterfactual latent completions. Gao--Wang sharply identify the structural-index set but give only valid counterfactual inequalities conditional on their full observed covariate vector. In the identity-verified April 2, 2026 Liu manuscript, Theorems 1--3 are sharp static results, while Section 8 explicitly describes its dynamic binary-choice restrictions as non-sharp, conditions the displayed counterfactual bounds only on the full exogenous path, and leaves further dynamic analysis to future work. Generic latent-space and adversarial frameworks formulate sharp programs but do not provide the proposed model-specific analytic projection in their inspected theorem text.
